newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo to spend 10 trln won in tech development.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo to spend 10 trln won in tech development.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Group said on Friday it planned to invest 10 trillion won over the next four years in enlarging its global network of technology development and research centres.
A spokesman for the Daewoo's think tank, the Institute for Advanced Engineering, said the group planned to set up 67 technology research centres, including 55 abroad, by 2000.
The group currently operates 53 such centres including 15 in the United States, Japan, Britain and Germany, he said.
Daewoo is targeting earnings of 250 billion won from technology exports in the year 2000, he said.
It would represent 0.5 percent of Daewoo's annual turnover of an estimated 50 trillion won in 2000, excluding figures in the financial and trading sectors, he said.
